title: Pastel de Capas (Layered Cake)

title: Pastel de Ciruela (Plum Cake)
description: A cake made with plums, sugar, and water.
steps: Put 1 pound of pitted plums in 1 pound of sugar with 1 glass of water until it reaches the point of "ante" (soft ball stage)
Meanwhile, work 1 pound of flour with 5 eggs, a pinch of salt and 0.5 pound of butter
Knead for half an hour and let rest for a quarter hour
Then stretch with a rolling pin and cut the dough to the size of the plate in which the cake will be made
Place on the plate very well adjusted, put in the oven and as soon as it bakes without taking color, remove it and place the plum on top
Take out some thin strips very straight and make on the plate a weave like a petate pattern
Put in the oven, when it browns remove and serve

title: Pastel de Conejo (Rabbit Pie)
description: A pastry dish made with rabbit, lard, and ham.

ingredients.name: one glass white wine or sherry

steps: Clean the rabbit well, cut it into pieces, and fry in lard and butter with salt
When it takes color, add ham pieces, pepper powder, and one teaspoon of flour
When browned, add one glass of white wine or sherry and a little broth
Once cooked, remove the rabbit and chop the livers that should be precooked, adding them to the sauce until it reduces to one quarter
Prepare a puff pastry dough, roll it with a pin, and use to cover a baking pan
Place in the oven to cook without browning
Layer the stewed rabbit at the desired height, adding olives, capers, truffles and mushrooms if available, salchichón slices, pieces of Extremadura chorizo with their fat, and hard-boiled egg slices
Cover with the sauce and top with another thin layer of puff pastry, decorating with small designs
Place in the oven to brown

title: Pastel de Frutas (Fruit Cake)
description: A cake made with figs, oranges, and coconut.

ingredients.name: 3 egg yolk breads (at ten centavos each)
1 liter of milk cooked with cream
1 tablespoon vanilla or 1 glass of sherry

steps: Chop about 15 chilacayotes, 15 figs, 10 oranges, 15 coconut candies and if available some candied lemons; chop everything very finely
Chop three egg yolk breads

Place in a mold greased with lard, alternating layers: a layer of chopped bread, a layer of sweets with pitted raisins, another layer of bread, and continue alternating the layers, ensuring the last layer is bread
In 1 liter of milk cooked with cream, add 3 whole eggs and 3 egg yolks, 4 ounces of sugar, and 1 tablespoon of vanilla or 1 glass of sherry
Beat very well and pour this mixture over the cake
This should be done at night to put it in the oven the next day, which will take two hours to bake

title: Pastel de Jugo de Limón (Lemon Juice Cake)
description: A cake made with butter or lard, lemons, and egg yolks.
steps: Make puff pastry dough with half a pound of flour, two eggs, a pinch of salt, and four ounces of butter or lard; knead well and roll out with a rolling pin.
Put a very thin layer on a pan or plate and bake in the oven just until cooked.
Beat four ounces of butter with the juice of three lemons, put on heat, and gradually add six tablespoons of sugar and six egg yolks without stopping to stir.
When thickened, cover the pastry with this mixture.
Beat the six egg whites as for turrón, add three tablespoons of powdered sugar and the zest of three lemons, cover the cream with this and bake in the oven until golden.

steps: After the fish is well cleaned, coat it in flour and fry it in sufficient hot lard.

Serve hot; it can be simmered for a few minutes in a baking dish or if desired, also placed in the oven.

Pour the sauce over it and garnish with olives, capers and one pepper sliced lengthwise.

title: Plátanos en gloria — cinnamon-syrup plantains
description: Ripe plantain slices are browned first, then simmered in a panela and honey syrup scented with cinnamon. Their tender centers and caramel-colored edges make a warm, richly sweet dessert.

title: Guatemalan-style three-ingredient polvorones
description: Crumbly, gently sweet cookies made with flour, sugar and lard. This Guatemalan-style version keeps the ingredient list simple, with lightly golden edges and a tender, sandy texture that pairs well with coffee.

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with baking parchment.
Mix {{item-2}} with {{item-1}} until evenly combined. Fold in {{item-0}} until a cohesive, soft dough forms; press together gently instead of kneading.

Bake on the middle rack for 18–22 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the tops look dry. Check from 15 minutes; the cookies will firm as they cool.
Leave on the sheet for 10 minutes, then transfer carefully to a rack to cool completely.

title: Repollos y Relámpagos (Cream Puffs and Éclairs)
description: Prepared with lard, caramel, and water.

ingredients.name: Eggs (eight to ten, depending on size)

steps: Put a saucepan on the heat with two glasses of water, four ounces of lard, and a pinch of salt.
When boiling, add half a pound of well-sifted flour, stir well and put back on the heat.
When it no longer sticks to the hand, remove it.
When cool, add eggs two by two; if they are large, eight eggs, if small, ten eggs; mix everything well and put it in a cloth bag with its respective tube.
On a buttered pan, place small pieces of the desired size; the éclairs are long and the cream puffs are round.
Put them in a very hot oven.

When cooked, remove them, split them down the middle with scissors and fill with a cream made as follows: put four ounces of flour, four ounces of sugar, three eggs (white and yolk) in a container; mix everything very well with half a liter of cooked milk; when everything is well mixed without lumps, put it on the heat to boil for ten minutes; coat with this cream and have caramel-point honey separate and glaze with this.

description: A soup made with chickpeas, lard, and cabbage.

ingredients.name: one French bread soaked in water and salt

steps: Soak half a pound of chickpeas in water the day before

When half cooked add salt and one large tablespoon of lard
After boiling five hours on slow even heat add cabbage, carrot, chayote, potatoes and a small piece of plantain, all finely chopped
Soak dried stockfish in very hot water and after ten minutes of soaking remove all the bones and add to the vegetables and chickpeas to boil for half an hour
Grind three or four roasted tomatoes, two roasted onions and three roasted garlic cloves
Take a bit of cumin, a bit of Castilian pepper, a bit of oregano, a small piece of achiote and grind with all the above and one French bread soaked in water and salt
Dissolve with a bit of cold water and add to the broth

ingredients.name: Two tablespoons of grated Flemish cheese
